text: In Crouch End, London, Shaun is a twenty-nine-year-old sales advisor whose girlfriend Liz [dumps him for never making plans|trigger|being spurned or shamed], leaving him drunk at the Winchester pub with his slacker best friend Ed. By morning [the dead have overrun London|threat|the dead that rise], and two of them in the garden are beaten to death with household implements and [Shaun's vinyl collection|images|weapons and tools]. Shaun plans to rescue his mother and Liz and wait it out at the pub, while one by one [the bitten turn|rules|it passes to others].
